items.exampleEn: Some flowers give off their scent only at night.
items.exampleZh: 有些花要到夜裡才會散發香味。

items.exampleEn: Her eyebrows are thick and dark, just like her father's.
items.exampleZh: 她的眉毛又濃又黑，跟她爸爸一模一樣。

items.exampleEn: I need a needle and some black thread.
items.exampleZh: 我需要一根針和一些黑線。

items.exampleEn: The baby has a single curl on top of her head.
items.exampleZh: 寶寶頭頂上有一撮捲髮。

items.exampleEn: The boy pulled his hood over his eyes and fell asleep on the bus.
items.exampleZh: 男孩把帽子拉下來遮住眼睛，在公車上睡著了。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother keeps her best linen tablecloth for special dinners.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶把她最好的亞麻桌布留到特別的晚餐才用。

items.exampleEn: Some companies ask workers to cover their tattoos at work.
items.exampleZh: 有些公司要求員工上班時把刺青遮起來。

items.exampleEn: This shop sells underwear made from natural cotton.
items.exampleZh: 這家店賣天然棉製的內衣褲。

items.sentenceEn: My coat has a hood, so I don't need an umbrella today.
items.sentenceZh: 我的外套有帽子，所以今天不需要雨傘。

items.audioEn: The thread on this button is loose. Can you sew it back on for me?
items.audioZh: 這顆鈕扣的線鬆了。你可以幫我縫回去嗎？

items.sentenceEn: Dogs can follow a scent for many kilometers.
items.sentenceZh: 狗可以循著氣味追蹤好幾公里。

items.sentenceEn: Tattoos are more common among young people today.
items.sentenceZh: 如今刺青在年輕人之間更普遍了。

items.stemEn: This summer dress is made of ____, so it feels cool and light.
items.stemZh: 這件夏季洋裝是亞麻做的，所以穿起來涼爽輕盈。

items.stemEn: He raised one ____ in surprise when I told him the news.
items.stemZh: 我告訴他這個消息時，他驚訝地挑起一邊眉毛。

items.passageEn: Before my trip to Thailand, I made a list of things to pack. Because the weather is hot, I chose light linen shirts and enough underwear for ten days. I also packed a jacket with a hood in case of rain. At a market in Bangkok, a woman sold affordable perfume with a lovely scent of flowers. Next to her, an artist was drawing temporary tattoos on tourists' arms. My sister got a small one, and the artist even fixed a loose thread on her dress for free. When I showed my mother the photos, she raised an eyebrow at the tattoo, but she loved the soft curls a market hairdresser had given my sister.
items.passageZh: 去泰國旅行前，我列了一張打包清單。因為天氣很熱，我選了輕薄的亞麻襯衫，還帶了夠穿十天的內衣褲。我也帶了一件有連身帽的外套，以防下雨。在曼谷的市集裡，一位婦人在賣價格實惠、帶有迷人花香的香水。她旁邊有位藝術家在幫遊客的手臂畫暫時性的刺青。我妹妹畫了一個小的，那位藝術家還免費幫她把洋裝上一根鬆掉的線縫好。我給媽媽看照片時，她對那個刺青挑了挑眉，但她很喜歡市集裡的髮型師幫我妹妹弄的柔軟捲髮。

questions.questionZh: 作者為什麼帶亞麻襯衫？
媽媽看到照片時，對什麼挑了挑眉？

items.promptZh: 旅行時，記得多帶幾件內衣褲。
referenceEn: When you travel, remember to bring some extra underwear.
Remember to pack extra underwear when you go on a trip.
rubricZh: underwear 是不可數名詞，不加 s（例如 some extra underwear）
「記得」可寫 remember to… 等；「帶」可寫 bring、pack 等

items.promptZh: 這家咖啡店裡充滿了剛出爐的麵包香味。
referenceEn: This coffee shop is full of the scent of bread just out of the oven.
The scent of warm bread from the oven fills this coffee shop.
rubricZh: scent 指「香味」（例如 the scent of bread 等）
「充滿」可寫，例如 is full of、fills 等
「剛出爐的麵包」可寫，例如 bread just out of the oven、freshly baked bread 等
